translated_text: To the Army on the 13th, My little one at 7. 1940, I forgot to say that you must send me your old work receipt as soon as possible. Please send it to me registered mail, it's (Hérault) #4, 'me Bon Camp Agde (Hérault) 17th Company. I need it for demobilization. See you soon my darling, Your Bob, Zweigenthal camp. Agde Hérault) 4.5-8 17th Company. Sender's Name and Address: FRENCH REPUBLIC CORRESPONDENCE CARD MAFM AGDE 7 Mrs. E. Zweigenthal (Ideal) Ist thing Shoncie (Idk) higiniac Corrèze HÉRAULT via Ussel
